item.title: Five Stripes ready to get season started
item.description: Atlanta United players Steven Alzate and Juan Berrocal are looking forward to starting the season on the road in Cincinnati, with the team hoping to build on last year's performance and take advantage of a healthy back line and new signing Fafa Picault. The post Five Stripes ready to get season started appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: A Tribute to Black Art: Music, creativity, and community action
item.description: A Tribute to Black Art is a benefit concert celebrating Black History Month through music, creativity, and collective action, with proceeds supporting Love Beyond Walls' Zion's Closet initiative to provide essential items to students and families in crisis. The post A Tribute to Black Art: Music, creativity, and community action appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Traditional Ethiopian cuisine meets modern flair at Ruki’s Kitchen
item.description: Ruki's Kitchen, a pop-up turned food stall, is making waves in Atlanta's local food scene with its modern take on traditional Ethiopian cuisine, created by Chef Ali Lemma, who left his banking job to pursue his passion for cooking. The post Traditional Ethiopian cuisine meets modern flair at Ruki’s Kitchen appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘He’s coming here to lie’: Democratic Party of Georgia welcomes Trump to Peach State
item.description: The Democratic Party of Georgia hosted a press conference to address Donald Trump's visit to Georgia, with speakers criticizing his administration for its impact on families and the economy, and highlighting the need for a senator who will challenge the Trump administration on behalf of Georgians. The post ‘He’s coming here to lie’: Democratic Party of Georgia welcomes Trump to Peach State appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Gubernatorial Forum takes place in Chamblee while Trump is in Rome
item.description: At a Democratic Gubernatorial forum in Chamblee, GA, seven candidates discussed topics ranging from education and healthcare reform to ICE's presence in Georgia and the FBI raid on the Board of Elections office, while also addressing the presence of Donald Trump in the state. The post Gubernatorial Forum takes place in Chamblee while Trump is in Rome appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: NASCAR’s Rajah Caruth gives back to his hometown
item.description: Atlanta-born NASCAR driver Rajah Caruth visited the Jesse Draper Boys and Girls Club to inspire middle schoolers with his journey in motorsports, emphasizing the importance of perseverance, resilience, and determination. item.title: Amanda Free named President of Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Georgia
item.description: Amanda Free has been named President of Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Georgia, bringing with her over 20 years of experience in sales, operations, and consulting, and a commitment to improving the health and well-being of Georgia's communities. The post Amanda Free named President of Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Georgia appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: “Catching the Moon: The Story of a Young Girl’s Baseball Dream” is playing now
item.description: "Catching the Moon: The Story of a Young Girl's Baseball Dream" is a musical production at Synchronicity Theatre that tells the true story of Marcenia "Toni Stone" Lyle, the first woman to play professional baseball in the Negro Leagues. The post “Catching the Moon: The Story of a Young Girl’s Baseball Dream” is playing now appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Le Nouveau Maquis to open second location in Tucker, Cuevacía now open in Atlanta
item.description: Le Nouveau Maquis, a West African restaurant, is opening a second location in Tucker, while Cuevacía, a Northern Mexico-inspired restaurant, has opened in Midtown, and Heritage, a restaurant focusing on the cuisines of Black and brown people, is set to open in Summerhill. The post Le Nouveau Maquis to open second location in Tucker, Cuevacía now open in Atlanta appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.
